name: pair
description: Understand code before you change it, then build the change with Claude step by step. explain traces a ticket, a flow, a module or a diff and has you say the key points back; pair lays the job out, stops where a decision is yours and lets you write the pieces you choose; review-standards explains what is wrong with a change and why it matters; debrief keeps what the session taught. One hook keeps pair markers out of commits. Needs no ticket, tracker or setup.
